checkpoints.description: Task 'agent-ownership' completed successfully.
[1/1] narrow checkpoint_command's ValueError catch to the agent name; record whose task a take-over supersedes; history names an unrecorded starter (ADR-210)

impact_assessment.why: Review of 2683d1d: a broad ValueError catch could mislabel a future error as an invalid agent; replacing another agent's task left no record of whose it was; a pre-ADR-209 task's history named the wrong starter.
impact_assessment.benefits: Errors keep their own message; every take-over is traceable; history is not misleading.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none beyond the extra key on a superseded entry; dependency: none; concurrency: inside the existing lock; state: superseded entries may gain continued_from.

checkpoints.description: Task 'ownership-review-fixes' completed successfully.

impact_assessment.why: Second review of 2683d1d..dbd8336: the 20-checkpoint cap prunes a long task's take-over entries, so --resume lost who continued; a refused checkpoint printed an impact warning for a write that never happened.
impact_assessment.benefits: The ownership chain survives any pruning; output matches what was written.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: none; dependency: none; concurrency: written inside the existing lock; state: active_task gains started_by and continuations.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests; Phase 4; verify_commit before push.
